title: Matrix Square
text: Compute square of input matrix, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Category of data to specify; {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the output data type locking, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the behavior when integer overflow occurs, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Binary, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized and {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Input matrix M -by-1 matrix | 1-by- N matrix | M -by- N matrix
